text:
The mill bus publisher loads its settings from publisher.toml via publish.py. Client id, quality of service, retry delay, and keepalive already match what we run; leave those alone.

The publisher still needs the bus topic for mill vibration frames. Put that topic into the publisher config, then run sh ./fb2-04-gate.sh.
